title: Connect Silent Improvements to Planning Agent

summary.goal: Replace mock silent improvements with real agent-driven analysis and suggestions
summary.context: The UI shows 'silent improvements' - background AI analysis that suggests enhancements (missing acceptance criteria, unclear descriptions, etc.). Currently mock. With relay, the planning agent periodically analyzes the plan and pushes improvement suggestions.

acceptance_criteria.description: Planning agent periodically analyzes plan for improvements
Accepted improvements applied via MCP tools
Falls back to mock when no active session
UI indicates 'AI Active' vs 'Demo Mode' (shared with relay-ai-chat)

steps.title: Define Improvement entity
steps.description: Create src/domain/improvement.ts with Improvement interface and factory.

acceptance_criteria.description: Improvement interface: { improvement_id, plan_id, type, description, suggested_change, status, created_at }
suggested_change: { tool: string, arguments: object } - MCP tool call to apply

steps.title: Add improvements storage
steps.description: Add improvements table to SQLite schema. Implement CRUD operations.

steps.title: Add suggest_improvement MCP tool
steps.description: Add new MCP tool: suggest_improvement(plan_id, type, description, suggested_change). Agent uses this to push suggestions.

acceptance_criteria.description: suggest_improvement tool available to planning agents
Tool accepts: { plan_id, type: ImprovementType, description, suggested_change }

steps.title: Add improvements endpoint
steps.description: Create GET /plans/:id/improvements endpoint. Returns list of pending improvement suggestions.

acceptance_criteria.description: All improvement endpoints return session_status: 'active' | 'none' alongside their primary response data
session_status reflects whether an active planning session exists for the plan

steps.title: Add session_status to all improvement API responses
steps.description: Update improvements.ts handlers to include session_status in all responses by checking for active planning session.

acceptance_criteria.description: session_status='active' when planning session exists for plan, 'none' otherwise

steps.title: Add apply improvement endpoint
steps.description: Create POST /plans/:id/improvements/:improvement_id/apply endpoint. Applies the suggested change via MCP tools.

acceptance_criteria.description: Endpoint calls MCP tool specified in suggested_change

steps.title: Add dismiss improvement endpoint
steps.description: Create POST /plans/:id/improvements/:improvement_id/dismiss endpoint. Marks improvement as dismissed.

steps.title: Update planning agent prompt for improvements
steps.description: Ensure planning agent system prompt (from relay-planning-agent.rpa001) includes instructions to periodically analyze plan and suggest improvements using suggest_improvement tool.

acceptance_criteria.description: System prompt instructs agent to analyze plan for improvements
Agent uses suggest_improvement tool for findings
Analysis triggered periodically or when plan structure changes

steps.note: Coordinates with relay-planning-agent.rpa001 - ensure prompt includes improvement instructions

steps.title: Update UI improvements API client
steps.description: Modify packages/planner-ui/src/api/improvements.ts to call real endpoints. Poll for new improvements.

steps.title: Update useAIImprovements hook
steps.description: Modify hook to use real API when session active. Use useAIConnectionStatus from relay-ai-chat for shared status indicator.

acceptance_criteria.description: Hook uses real API when useAIConnectionStatus.isConnected=true
Falls back to mock improvements when no session
Shares connection status with chat via useAIConnectionStatus hook

steps.note: Reuses useAIConnectionStatus hook created in relay-ai-chat.rac005

steps.title: Add tests for improvements integration
steps.description: Test improvements flow: agent pushing improvements, API endpoints, UI integration.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tests for apply and dismiss flows

cases.description: GET /improvements returns session_status='none' when no active session
GET /improvements returns session_status='active' when session exists
GET /improvements/pending returns session_status='none' when no active session
GET /improvements/pending returns session_status='active' when session exists
GET /improvements/:id returns session_status='none' when no active session
GET /improvements/:id returns session_status='active' when session exists
POST /improvements/:id/accept returns session_status='none' when no active session
POST /improvements/:id/accept returns session_status='active' when session exists
POST /improvements/:id/dismiss returns session_status='none' when no active session
POST /improvements/:id/dismiss returns session_status='active' when session exists

data_requirements: Test plan with at least one version
Helper to create active session: { session_id, plan_id, status: 'active', ... }
Second test improvement for dismiss test (since accept/dismiss consume the improvement)
implementation_notes: Add describe block 'session_status in responses' to improvements.test.ts
Session status: 'active' if session exists, 'none' otherwise
All 5 endpoints need the same session_status logic added to handlers
